study_identification_part.si_4_title: Dissecting Heterogeneity in Functional Network Connectivity Aberrations in Antipsychotic Medication-Naïve First Episode Psychosis Patients - A Normative Modeling Study

nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: Normative modeling performed using the PCN toolkit; specific algorithm not reported.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: Here, we used the Predictive Clinical Neuroscience (PCN) toolkit (version 0.27), a publicly available Python package, for normative modeling of resting state connectivity data.

nm2_2_response_variable.detail: Resting-state functional connectivity matrix (136 connectivity values) derived from Yeo-17 network parcellation.
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: Functional brain networks were then parcellated using the Yeo-17 functional network parcellation atlas, resulting in a functional connectivity matrix of 136 connectivity values.

nm2_3_explanatory_variables.detail: Predictor variables used in the normative model were not reported.
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.supporting_text: The normative model was generated using resting state connectivity data from approximately 22,000 healthy individuals across the lifespan (age range (yrs): 2-100).
